requirement: Return every live clinical variable as an id, name, and code item, sorted by name ascending and read without tracking; soft-deleted variables are excluded by the query filter.

preconditions.text: The clinical variable table contains the rows seeded for the case
One of the seeded variables is soft-deleted
The table holds variables of every value type
The clinical variable table is empty

inputs.text: Query with no parameters over three variables inserted out of order
Query with no parameters over live variables plus a soft-deleted one
Query with no parameters over boolean, numeric, and categorical variables
Query with no parameters on an empty database

returns.text: Success with ApplicationStatus.Success and a non-null result
Variables sorted by name ascending, each carrying its id, name, and code
Soft-deleted variables are excluded from the list
The list is value-type agnostic and includes every subtype
An empty list is returned when no live variable exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
